comments.content: FullDocumentDiagnosticReport.Kind is no longer set. The original code returned Kind: lsproto.StringLiteralFull{}. Removing it changes the report shape and may break LSP clients that expect Kind to be populated.

toLSPDiagnostic is invoked with nil converters. toLSPDiagnostic previously received l.converters and likely uses it to map file paths/positions to LSP URIs. Passing nil will panic or produce incorrect diagnostics. Pass l.converters instead of nil, or make toLSPDiagnostic nil-safe.
